content: We use XNLI dataset BIBREF9 for classification task and Universal Dependencies v2.4 BIBREF21 for parsing task. Since a language might have more than one treebank in Universal Dependencies, we use the following treebanks: en_ewt (English), fr_gsd (French), ru_syntagrus (Russian) ar_padt (Arabic), vi_vtb (Vietnamese), hi_hdtb (Hindi), and zh_gsd (Chinese).
